content.short: Banking Circle is a licensed Luxembourg bank providing cross-border payments and accounts to other financial firms.
content.description: Banking Circle is a bank whose customers are other regulated financial institutions rather than the public. It clears payments, holds multi-currency accounts and handles foreign exchange and treasury for payment companies and banks that would otherwise depend on a chain of correspondents. Direct central bank access is what makes that possible, and the scale is substantial at roughly 1.5 trillion euros moved each year for more than 850 clients, with over 35 million virtual IBANs issued. It is licensed in Luxembourg and has been running for about a decade.
